prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Companion", "Select a pet to see their unique animations and personality traits in real-time.", "Choose pet personality"]
1: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Try out these simple gestures to interact with your pet on your desktop.", "Click pet to interact | Drag pet to move | Right-click to hide"]
2: ["Explore Your Journey Options", "Swipe to preview custom photo generation versus instant preset adoption.", "Preview Path Types"]
3: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe", "Link your account to save your companion across desktop restarts and devices.", "Already have a pet? Sign in with your previous account to restore them.", "Continue with Account"]
4: ["Crafting Your Pet...", "Your pet is getting ready to land on your desktop!", "Generating assets..."]
5: ["Verifying Desktop Visibility", "Can you see your pet floating on your desktop screen?", "Desktop Pet Rendering Test", "Yes, I see my pet!"]
6: ["Use well-lit, clear front-facing photos for best 3D pet generation results.", "Tip 1: Good lighting | Tip 2: Clear face | Tip 3: Single subject"]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new desktop companion a name to make it official!", "Pet Name", "Official Pet License"]
8: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Scroll through to discover how your desktop companion brings your workspace to life."]
9: ["Pin Desktop Pet to your taskbar for quick access anytime!", "Pin to Taskbar", "Quick Access Enabled"]
